pages.title: Find a Dealer
pages.text: An unemployed villager can claim a wood or iron drying table as a workstation. Look in village greenhouses too. Trade like you would with a vanilla villager. Stock varies by villager and tier.

pages.title: Dealer Stock
pages.text: Novices can offer cannabis, coca, peyote, muffins and cigarettes. Level two adds dried ingredients and tools. Level three can offer magic mushrooms, bongs, syringes, LSD pills or LSA squares.

pages.title: Farmer Stock
pages.text: Novice farmers can supply grapes, hop seeds or cones, tobacco supplies, mugs, coffee beans or cherries. Farmers also keep their vanilla offers. The server’s farmerDrugDeals setting controls the added pool.

pages.title: Dealer Work
pages.text: Dealers can work nearby farmland, plant seeds, apply bonemeal and dry ingredients. Keep the work area reachable and its crops lit. Mob griefing controls their ability to change crops.

pages.title: A Risky Trade
pages.text: Feeding a hash muffin to some villagers can create an addict that buys preparations. Addicts can be injured by trades and restocking. Keep your ordinary farmers and dealers for renewable supplies.
